title: Modified Phenol Chloroform Genomic DNA Extraction Protocol
author: Shelby J Barnes
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.b5iiq4ce
materials: Invert samples thoroughly before centrifuge step.
Invert sample thoroughly before centrifuge step.

steps.title: Prepare Cell Pellet
steps.instruction: Start with filtered cells or spin a liquid culture to obtain a pellet, then pipette off any remaining supernatant.

steps.title: Initial Lysis and Incubation
steps.instruction: Add 380 uL 1x TE Buffer and 20 uL Lysozyme to the sample and incubate for 1 h at 37˚C.

steps.title: Protein Digestion
steps.instruction: Add 60 uL SDS, 30 uL Proteinase K, and 110 uL 1x TE Buffer (bringing total volume to 600 uL) to the sample.

substeps.instruction: Incubate for 2 h at 37˚C
Vortex tube thoroughly
Incubate at 37˚C for 1 h, or until samples are clear
Incubate at 65˚C for 30 min to inactivate Proteinase K

steps.title: Phenol Chloroform Extraction
steps.instruction: Perform a P/C/I extraction to isolate the aqueous phase.

substeps.instruction: Add equal volume (600 uL) of Phenol Chloroform Isoamyl alcohol (P/C/I) to sample
Spin at 10,640 rcf for 10 min
Transfer approximately 500 - 600 uL of the aqueous phase (top layer) to a new tube in 100 uL increments

steps.title: Chloroform Isoamyl Alcohol Extraction
steps.instruction: Perform a C/I extraction to further purify the DNA.

substeps.instruction: Add equal volume of Chloroform Isoamyl alcohol (C/I) to sample
Spin at 10,640 rcf for 10 min
Transfer aqueous phase (top layer) to new tube

steps.title: Ethanol Precipitation
steps.instruction: Precipitate the DNA using ice-cold ethanol and sodium acetate.

substeps.instruction: Add 2 volumes of ice cold 100% Ethanol to sample (e.g., 100 uL Ethanol for 50 uL DNA solution)
Add 0.1 volumes of 3M Sodium Acetate pH 5.2 to sample (e.g., 5 uL Sodium Acetate for 50 uL DNA solution)
Incubate at -20˚C for at least 1 hr (longer incubation, e.g., overnight, may increase yield)
Spin at 13,000 rcf for 30 min at 4˚C

steps.title: DNA Pellet Wash
steps.instruction: Wash the DNA pellet to remove salts and residual ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Pipette off supernatant
Gently add 150 uL of 70% ethanol without dislodging the pellet (keep samples on ice or in cold racks)
Spin at 13,000 rcf for 10 min at 4˚C
Pipette off supernatant
Spin at 13,000 rcf for 1 min to bring down any excess ethanol
Pipette off any remaining liquid

steps.title: Resuspension and Quantification
steps.instruction: Dry the pellet and resuspend for quantification.

substeps.instruction: Dry pellet for 5 min MAX
Resuspend pellet in 50 uL Molecular Bio water
Use 1- 3 uL of DNA to quantify using Qubit HS dsDNA assay kit
Store at -20˚C
